005package org.wpilib.tunable;
006
007import java.util.function.BooleanSupplier;
008import org.wpilib.util.function.BooleanConsumer;
009
010/** A tunable boolean. */
011public abstract class TunableBoolean extends TunableBase
012    implements BooleanSupplier, BooleanConsumer {
013  /**
014   * Creates a tunable boolean with the initial value of false.
015   *
016   * @return a tunable boolean
017   */
018  public static TunableBoolean create() {
019    return create(false);
020  }
021
022  /**
023   * Creates a tunable boolean with the given initial value.
024   *
025   * @param initialValue initial value
026   * @return a tunable boolean
027   */
028  public static TunableBoolean create(boolean initialValue) {
029    return createConfig(initialValue, null);
030  }
031
032  /**
033   * Creates a tunable boolean with the given getter and setter.
034   *
035   * <p>The getter and setter must not throw.
036   *
037   * @param getter getter for the tunable value
038   * @param setter setter for the tunable value
039   * @return a tunable boolean
040   */
041  public static TunableBoolean create(BooleanSupplier getter, BooleanConsumer setter) {
042    return createConfig(getter, setter, null);
043  }
044
045  /**
046   * Creates a tunable boolean with the given config and an initial value of false.
047   *
048   * @param config tunable config
049   * @return a tunable boolean
050   */
051  public static TunableBoolean createConfig(TunableConfig config) {
052    return createConfig(false, config);
053  }
054
055  /**
056   * Creates a tunable boolean with the given initial value and config.
057   *
058   * @param initialValue initial value
059   * @param config tunable config
060   * @return a tunable boolean
061   */
062  public static TunableBoolean createConfig(boolean initialValue, TunableConfig config) {
063    return new TunableBoolean(config, true) {
064      @Override
065      public void set(boolean value) {
066        if (m_value == value) {
067          return;
068        }
069        m_value = value;
070        markChanged();
071      }
072
073      @Override
074      public boolean get() {
075        return m_value;
076      }
077
078      private boolean m_value = initialValue;
079    };
080  }
081
082  /**
083   * Creates a tunable boolean with the given getter, setter, and config.
084   *
085   * <p>The getter and setter must not throw.
086   *
087   * @param getter getter for the tunable value
088   * @param setter setter for the tunable value
089   * @param config tunable config
090   * @return a tunable boolean
091   */
092  public static TunableBoolean createConfig(
093      BooleanSupplier getter, BooleanConsumer setter, TunableConfig config) {
094    if (config == null) {
095      config = TunableConfig.of(TunableOption.ALWAYS_GET);
096    } else if (config.getPolling() == TunableConfig.Polling.DEFAULT) {
097      config = config.withPolling(TunableConfig.Polling.ALWAYS_GET);
098    }
099    return new TunableBoolean(config, true) {
100      @Override
101      public void set(boolean value) {
102        boolean changed = getter.getAsBoolean() != value;
103        if (setter != null) {
104          setter.accept(value);
105        }
106        if (changed) {
107          markChanged();
108        }
109      }
110
111      @Override
112      public boolean get() {
113        return getter.getAsBoolean();
114      }
115    };
116  }
117
118  /**
119   * Constructs a tunable boolean.
120   *
121   * @param config tunable config
122   */
123  protected TunableBoolean(TunableConfig config) {
124    super(config);
125  }
126
127  /**
128   * Constructs a tunable boolean.
129   *
130   * @param config tunable config
131   * @param supportsChangeNotification whether the tunable notifies backends when it changes
132   */
133  protected TunableBoolean(TunableConfig config, boolean supportsChangeNotification) {
134    super(config, supportsChangeNotification);
135  }
136
137  /**
138   * Sets the value.
139   *
140   * <p>Implementations must not throw.
141   *
142   * @param value value
143   */
144  public abstract void set(boolean value);
145
146  /**
147   * Gets the value.
148   *
149   * <p>Implementations must not throw.
150   *
151   * @return value
152   */
153  public abstract boolean get();
154
155  @Override
156  public boolean getAsBoolean() {
157    return get();
158  }
159
160  @Override
161  public void accept(boolean value) {
162    set(value);
163  }
164}
